title: How claude-canvas works end to end
description: What happens from /visualize X to a live-editable canvas, including how Claude updates trigger SSE hot-swaps in the browser.

nodes.label: ▶ START
nodes.content: User wants a visualization. Types a trigger phrase in Claude Code.

nodes.label: 1. "/visualize X"
nodes.content: Any natural trigger (visualize, draw, diagram, show on canvas) activates the skill.

nodes.label: Claude
nodes.content: Reads SKILL.md, runs preflight + self-check, generates schema-valid JSON, writes it to disk, then runs the bootstrap.

nodes.label: SKILL.md
nodes.content: 400 lines of rules: 7-question preflight, diagram-type table, node/edge disambiguation, 12 self-checks, 12 anti-patterns.

nodes.label: 2. Write JSON file
nodes.content: Claude uses the Write tool to save data/diagrams/<id>.json. This file is the source of truth on disk.

nodes.label: data/diagrams/<id>.json
nodes.content: Per-user, gitignored. One file = one diagram. Validated against server/schema.mjs.

nodes.label: 3. Run ensure-running.mjs
nodes.content: Idempotent bootstrap. Reads data/server.lock and decides whether to spawn the server.

nodes.label: data/server.lock
nodes.content: { pid, port, started_at }. Liveness tested via process.kill(pid, 0).

nodes.label: 4. Server alive?
nodes.content: If lockfile exists and PID responds: reuse. Otherwise: spawn server.mjs on a random free port.

nodes.label: 5. Open browser tab
nodes.content: Bootstrap auto-opens http://127.0.0.1:<port>/#/<id>. If a tab is already open, reuses it via SSE instead.

nodes.label: Browser (tldraw)
nodes.content: Loads pre-built React+tldraw bundle from server. Subscribes to /api/events for live updates.

nodes.label: 6. Render cards + arrows
nodes.content: GET /api/diagrams/<id> → tldraw store. Custom CardShape paints typed cards; arrows bind for native reconnection.

nodes.label: ✓ Visible + editable
nodes.content: User sees the diagram. Can drag, connect, reattach, edit labels, delete — all GPU-rendered on canvas.

nodes.label: User drags / edits
nodes.content: tldraw fires onChange. Debounced 600ms to avoid flooding the network.

nodes.label: POST /api/save
nodes.content: Browser sends full shape state. Server validates via schema.mjs and writes the file atomically (temp + rename).

nodes.label: SSE diagram:update
nodes.content: Server broadcasts to every connected browser. Any other open tab hot-swaps without reload.
